stories.headline: Spout Labs releases Brew 3 as an open model
stories.text: Brew 3 is free to download and run on your own machines. It reads 400,000 words at once and answers in half the time of Brew 2. The lab says it matches closed rivals on coding tests. An open model means you can build on it without paying for each request.

stories.headline: Teapot AI raises $2bn at a $40bn valuation
stories.text: Teapot AI raised $2bn from investors. That values it at $40bn, double what it was six months ago. Money still pours into AI makers, whatever the doubts.

stories.headline: Kettle Corp shares fall 6% on spending doubts
stories.text: Kettle Corp's shares fell 6% on Tuesday, a day after a 31% jump. Investors asked when its AI spending will pay back. The swing shows how unsure the market is about AI profits.

stories.headline: The Made-up Union fines a chatbot maker €30m
stories.text: It is the first fine under the Union's AI law. The maker didn't tell users its bot was a machine. Anyone shipping a chatbot there now has an example of what the law asks.

stories.headline: Pourer 2.0 lets agents open pull requests
stories.text: Agents in Pourer can now open a pull request, run the tests and ask for a review. A person still merges the change. It is a step from agents that suggest code to agents that hand in finished work.

stories.headline: A paper halves the memory long prompts need
stories.text: Long prompts, the text a model reads at once, use a lot of memory. This method keeps only the useful parts and halves that memory. Readers gave it 94 upvotes.

stories.headline: Made-up Phone recalls 2 million handsets over battery fires
stories.text: The recall covers two models sold since March. Battery fires are the reason.

stories.headline: One writer weighs whether the kettle boom is a bubble
stories.text: Writer Ada Pot argues the spending is real but the profits are not yet. She lists what would prove her wrong. It is one view, and a useful check on the excitement.

stories.headline: Builders argue about the made-up rules for open kettles
stories.text: A thread about the made-up rules drew 1,886 points. Builders argued about what the rules mean for open models.
